title: Blockchain Smart Contract Testing Template — Companion
title_es: Plantilla de Testing de Smart Contracts Blockchain — Companion
description: Downloadable testing log for EVM smart contracts: blank document covering contract details, unit coverage, access control, gas budget, vulnerability checklist, upgrade tests, integration, deployment verification, defect tracking and sign-off, plus a completed sample for a fictional ERC-20.
description_es: Documento de testing descargable para smart contracts EVM: plantilla en blanco con datos del contrato, cobertura unitaria, control de acceso, presupuesto de gas, checklist de vulnerabilidades, tests de upgrade, integración, verificación de deployment, seguimiento de defectos y sign-off, más un ejemplo completado de un ERC-20 ficticio.
